item.title: Burn bans in effect for 10 Iowa counties amid snow drought
item.description: IOWA -- On Monday, three new burn bans went into effect, bringing the total number of affected counties in Iowa to ten. The three new bans include Clinton, Scott, and Muscatine counties. The majority of the burn bans went into effect in early February and include: Clarke, Crawford, Decatur, Shelby, Union, Warren, and Wayne counties. [...]

item.title: Ava Heiden scores career-high 27 and No. 13 Iowa women beat Nebraska for a 20-win season
item.description: Ava Heiden had a career-high 27 points and 11 rebounds, Taylor Stremlow added a career-high 17 points, and No. 13 Iowa beat Nebraska 80-67 on Monday to sweep the season series.
